senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.2.5 vimalam विमलम्
Iron pyrite
Ferrous disulfide (FeS2). In calcinated form vimalam is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.

ITA-4.8.7 vimārgagamanam विमार्गगमनम्
Body channel dysfunction involving displacement of contents
Diversion to the flow of the contents and movement in the wrong body channels.

ITA-9.6.112 vimlāpanakarma विम्लापनकर्म
Gentle massage for management of pre-ulcerative inflammation
A localized, gentle massage carried out using bamboo reeds, palms or the thumb to resolve inflammation.

ITA-9.6.125 vimlāpanakarma (vraṇacikitsā) विम्लापनकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Gentle therapeutic massage for wound management
Therapeutic application of a gentle massage.
